note: Seasonal access rules researched from agency pages (sources per rule). Windows are typical dates; the real gate dates move with snow each year. 'closed' = no car access in the window; 'permit' = a parking permit is needed in the window; 'info' = always-true notes.

rules.text: Multnomah County closes the upper road at a snow gate near milepost 10 (about 2,300 ft) every autumn, usually late November, and reopens it in late May or June. From the gate it's about 4.5 miles more to the summit lot.
Forest Road 99 to Windy Ridge is open roughly July 1 to November 30. A slide on FR 25 means the only way in is from the north via Randle.

SR 504 is closed at the winter gate (milepost 45.2) since the 2023 South Coldwater slide. WSDOT is rebuilding the Spirit Lake Outlet Bridge; the observatory is expected to reopen in spring 2027. Coldwater Lake and everything below the gate stay open.
SR 410 over Chinook Pass closes each winter (as early as late October; it closed Oct. 24 in 2025) and usually reopens late May to June; Tipsoo Lake often opens later than the pass.
src: WSDOT: Chinook and Cayuse passes close, Oct. 24, 2025

rules.text: Stevens Canyon Road past the Paradise junction is closed in winter. In winter you can still reach the lakes on snowshoes from the Paradise side (the Longmire–Paradise road is open most winter days).
src: NPS Mount Rainier newspaper (winter road closures)

rules.text: On Yakama Nation land (Tract D), open to the public only for a short summer window set each year (2025: July 18 to Sept. 8), with a cash day-use fee. Check the Yakama Nation's dates before going.
src: Oregon Hikers: Bird Creek Meadows Loop

rules.text: Forest Road 2656 to the lake is gated to cars in winter (gates usually close in early December). Park at Trillium Sno-Park on US 26 and walk or snowshoe about 2 miles down to the lake.
Oregon Sno-Park permit required to park, Nov. 1 to Apr. 30 ($4/day, $25/season; Washington permits aren't accepted). Carry chains or traction tires on US 26 and OR 35.

There is no bridge over the Sandy River on this trail any more: you cross on logs or wade, and the river rises in the afternoon. Forest Road 1825 is gated at the Sandy River in winter once there's about a foot of snow.
Forest Road 83 is gated at Marble Mountain Sno-Park from about Dec. 1 until it melts out in late May or June. In winter it's a 5–6 mile ski, snowshoe or (on dry years) bike ride from the gate.
Washington Sno-Park permit required at Marble Mountain, Cougar and Trail of Two Forests Sno-Parks, Dec. 1 to Mar. 31 (Oregon permits aren't accepted). Buy it before you go.
Forest Roads 23 and 2329 are usually under snow from late fall into early summer; the area's season runs roughly June to November. Call the Mt. Adams Ranger District early in the season.
Forest Road 4891 is an unimproved high-clearance road that's snowbound in winter; the nearby campground runs mid-May to mid-October.
